title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Anthropic ships model selection + reasoning into Claude voice mode (Jul 23)
bullets.summary: Voice mode is no longer hard-wired to Haiku: it inherits the last model used in text chat (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku), can think through hard problems out loud, and defaults to the fastest variant of the chosen tier.
bullets.how: Makes hands-free operation of a Construct agent viable for real work (dictated triage, on-the-go strategy) rather than only quick lookups; useful for Bobby's mobile workflow, less so for headless jobs.

bullets.title: MCP 2026-07-28 stateless spec is now 4 days out — the breaking rewrite ratifies Tuesday
bullets.summary: The stateless core (no session id, any request to any instance, OAuth-aligned auth, formal deprecation policy) plus MCP Apps (server-rendered UI) and the Tasks extension ratify Jul 28; beta SDKs are already shipping.
bullets.how: Every MCP server The Construct runs is 4 days from a breaking change; close the migration inventory + hardening checklist before Tuesday. The Tasks extension maps directly onto our long-running scan jobs. Load-bearing action of the week.

bullets.title: Claude Developer Platform — Managed Agents gain model-effort settings, expanded webhooks, and session seeding (July)
bullets.summary: You can set an effort level on a Managed Agents model config, get webhook coverage for environment + memory-store events, seed a session with initial events, and add optional version checks on updates.
bullets.how: Direct control surface for The Construct's agent fleet: dial effort (cost/quality) per job, wire memory/env events into our dashboards, and seed context so scan agents start warm instead of cold.

bullets.title: Revid.ai launches an MCP server + CLI for end-to-end AI video production (Jul 16)
bullets.summary: Stable-named tools (render_video, clone_voice, schedule_publish, publish_now) let an agent run script -> render -> voiceover -> caption -> publish in one call across nine workflows, with OAuth 2.1 for hosted clients.
bullets.how: Closest off-the-shelf analog to a Brand 9 Signs creative-ops pipeline: one Construct agent turns a signage brief into finished motion/spot assets and schedules the post, no editor in the loop.

bullets.title: arXiv — 'Context Engineering: From Prompts to Corporate Multi-Agent Architecture' (2603.09619)
bullets.summary: Frames capability maturity as a four-level pyramid — intent engineering -> specification engineering -> prompt engineering -> context engineering — for scaling from single prompts to governed corporate multi-agent systems.
bullets.how: A clean maturity model for where The Construct sits: past prompt-level, operating at the context/architecture tier — a useful audit lens for which agents still write prompts vs. engineer context.

praxis_lesson: The through-line this week is per-call effort control — voice mode inheriting a model tier, Managed Agents exposing an effort setting — so the same Construct agent now spans cost/quality tiers on demand, and the discipline shifts from 'which model' to 'govern how much effort each job is allowed to spend.' The load-bearing move stays the Jul-28 stateless-MCP migration + hardening inventory (4 days out); the standing hook is least-authority scoping on every new write-capable connector. Watch: Claude Opus 5 still rumored, not confirmed on anthropic.com/news as of this fire — capture it as a dated item the instant it ships.
